subject: OpenBMB MiniCPM5-2B open-weight model, Hugging Face revision a063f08de1bd09dfc9ae4cf3da35e6064949e533, September 2026
central_claim: MiniCPM5-2B is a publishable AI engineering topic because the official Hugging Face model card, OpenBMB GitHub README, public Hugging Face API metadata, raw config and linked training datasets support a bounded E2/R2 claim: OpenBMB released an Apache-2.0 2.5B-parameter Llama-style long-context model that makes local agent and tool-calling experiments more inspectable and deployable, while benchmark superiority remains a vendor-authored claim.

selection.reason: MiniCPM5-2B was created on Hugging Face on 2026-09-06 and last modified on 2026-09-08. It is a fresh open-weight release with public model metadata, raw config, safetensors artifact listing, Apache-2.0 license tag, model card, GitHub README, tool-calling template and vLLM/SGLang/Transformers execution paths. The conclusion is bounded to inspectable architecture and engineering implications because this turn did not download the 5GB checkpoint or rerun benchmarks.

claims.claim: OpenBMB released MiniCPM5-2B as a public, ungated Apache-2.0 open-weight text-generation model with 2,516,756,480 BF16 parameters, 42 LlamaForCausalLM layers, 131,072-token context, tool-calling template and documented vLLM/SGLang/Transformers execution paths; the publishable conclusion is about inspectable local-agent deployment conditions, not independently proven benchmark superiority.

Opened the official MiniCPM5-2B Hugging Face model card. It identifies the model as an Apache-2.0 transformers text-generation model with safetensors, English and Chinese support, long-context, tool-calling and on-device tags. The card documents MiniCPM5-2B as a dense 2B Transformer, local assistant/coding-agent/tool-use target, 131,072 context length, linked datasets, benchmark table, training recipe, vLLM/SGLang/Transformers quickstarts and SGLang tool-call parser guidance.

Opened the OpenBMB MiniCPM GitHub README. It repeats MiniCPM5-2B's architecture, parameter count, layer count, GQA heads, context length, evaluation summary, base/mid/post-training recipe, public dataset links, vLLM and SGLang serving examples and DSpark speculative decoding path.

Fetched Hugging Face API and raw config.
